negative_findings.description: No Albanian-language Kosovo outlet was found that operates a structured, machine-readable corporate press-release wire (a 'njoftim për media' distribution service) for banks. Bank releases appear to reach the public only via each bank's own site and via general news portals/agencies.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches on 'njoftim për media bankë Kosovë' returned bank sites, BQK PDFs and general portals, but no PR-wire service.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Release capture must be done outlet-by-outlet and bank-by-bank; there is no single sq wire to subscribe to, which raises collection cost and latency risk for A1.

negative_findings.description: Probes for the economy sections of gazetaexpress.com, kosova-sot.info and indeksonline.net did not return their section URLs; only homepages or encyclopedic entries surfaced.
negative_findings.result_summary: Site-path queries returned homepages / third-party pages rather than the requested /ekonomi sections.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Section-level entry points for these outlets remain unconfirmed; a crawler needs the real section paths, so a targeted on-site navigation pass is required before these are added as feeds.

negative_findings.description: This cell is scoped to Albanian-language media, so Serbian-language (sr) Kosovo outlets (e.g. north-Kosovo Serb media) were not searched; sr terms such as 'bankarski sektor Kosovo', 'dobit banaka' were not used here.
negative_findings.result_summary: No sr-language queries were run in this slice by design.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The sr signal layer for Kosovo banking/payments — especially the dinar/euro payments question and banking access in Serb-majority municipalities — is not covered by this slice and must be covered by a sibling cell.

negative_findings.description: RSS/Atom availability was not confirmed for any of the sq outlets listed; feed paths were inferred (e.g. WordPress /feed) but not tested.
negative_findings.result_summary: No feed URL was observed in search results.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection method for most candidates is currently 'index crawl', which is more fragile and heavier than feed polling; a feed-discovery pass would materially cut cost.

coverage_gaps.description: No per-bank tracking of the sq-language newsroom output about each named Kosovo bank (Raiffeisen Bank Kosovo, ProCredit Bank, TEB, NLB Banka, BKT Kosovë, Banka Ekonomike, BPB, Banka Kombëtare Tregtare, Ziraat) — coverage so far is sector-aggregate.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build an actor map of the ~11 licensed commercial banks plus non-bank payment institutions (e.g. OneFor) with sq name variants and run per-entity queries across the listed outlets.

coverage_gaps.description: Executive-appointment and board-change reporting (emërime, largime, bordi drejtues) was not specifically probed in this slice.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add sq query set: 'emërohet drejtor i ri bankë Kosovë', 'kryeshefi ekzekutiv i bankës', 'bordi drejtues BQK miraton'.

coverage_gaps.description: Social/messaging channels of sq economic outlets (e.g. Buletini Ekonomik on X and Facebook) were seen but not evaluated as collection surfaces; in Kosovo these often carry the release before the website item.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Assess outlet social accounts as low-latency alerting surfaces, subject to platform ToS and API access constraints.

coverage_gaps.description: No sq-language archive or paywalled back-catalogue route was identified for older Kosovo banking coverage (pre-2015), and several outlets rotate or renumber article URLs.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pair every captured sq article with a web-archive snapshot at capture time to guarantee retrievability for long-term intelligence.

coverage_gaps.description: Several domains here (kallxo.com, nacionale.com, kosovapress.com, sbunker.org) were identified by brand and appeared in result listings, but their banking sections were not opened, so section paths and current liveness are unconfirmed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Let the deterministic liveness pass resolve these; do not downgrade on a single failed fetch — 403/timeout on Kosovo portals commonly means bot-defended-but-live.

brief: Kosovo's Albanian-language media layer for banking and payments is broad but shallow: one genuine specialist (Buletini Ekonomik), a second economy-only portal (Ekonomia Online), and then a dozen general-news portals (Telegrafi, Koha, Zëri, Insajderi, Gazeta Express, Klan Kosova, KosovaPress, Nacionale, Bota Sot, Veriu.info) that mostly re-voice BQK announcements and annual aggregate figures. Analytical depth comes not from newsrooms but from think tanks — Instituti GAP and Riinvest — whose sq data notes are the pieces the media then quote, making them useful upstream pointers back to BQK primary data; RFE/RL's Albanian service is the most credible explanatory source on regulatory decisions such as the euro-only payments rule. The fastest discovery surface is the Gjirafa Kosovo-filtered economy aggregator, and an unexpected non-media signal is KalkuloKredi, which exposes advertised per-bank loan pricing ahead of any disclosure. Main weaknesses to close: no sq PR wire exists so releases must be captured per outlet, per-bank entity tracking and executive-change signals are not yet covered, and the Serbian-language layer is out of this cell's scope entirely.
